rules.title: Node.js cannot resolve a module
rules.summary: The requested package or file is absent from the active module-resolution path.
causes: Dependencies were not installed for this workspace.
The import name or relative path is wrong.
A build step did not generate the expected file.
actions: Read the missing module name from the first error.
Confirm it is declared in the correct package and workspace.
For relative imports, verify filename case and the built output path.

rules.title: npm found incompatible peer dependencies
rules.summary: Two packages require peer versions that cannot be selected together.
causes: A package upgrade crossed a peer-dependency boundary.
The root project pins a version outside a plugin's supported range.
actions: Read both conflicting version ranges in the ERESOLVE report.
Choose package versions whose peer ranges overlap.
Avoid --force or --legacy-peer-deps unless you have verified runtime compatibility.

rules.title: The active Node.js version is unsupported
rules.summary: A package's engines or devEngines requirement does not include the current runtime.
causes: The terminal is using a different Node.js version than the project.
A dependency dropped support for the current major version.
actions: Compare node --version with package.json and the repository's version files.
Switch to a supported runtime, or select a dependency release that supports the required runtime.

rules.title: package.json and the lockfile disagree
rules.summary: npm ci requires package-lock.json to exactly represent package.json.

any: can only install packages when your package\.json and package-lock\.json

causes: package.json changed without committing the regenerated lockfile.
A merge resolved the manifest and lockfile inconsistently.
actions: Use the repository's expected npm version.
Run npm install once to update the lockfile, review the diff, and commit both files together.

rules.title: node-gyp cannot find a native build toolchain
rules.summary: A native Node.js addon needs a supported compiler, Python, and platform build tools.

any: Could not find any Visual Studio installation
No Xcode or CLT version detected

causes: The platform compiler toolchain is not installed.
node-gyp selected an unsupported Python or compiler version.
actions: Install the platform prerequisites listed by node-gyp for your operating system.
Check the package's supported Node.js and ABI versions before building from source.

rules.title: An npm install script is not approved
rules.summary: npm blocked a dependency lifecycle script under the project's install-script policy.
causes: The dependency has an install-time script that has not been reviewed.
The package needs an implicit native rebuild.
actions: Inspect the package and the exact lifecycle script before approving it.
Record an explicit allow or deny decision in the project policy.
Do not bypass the policy for every dependency.
